subject: Workplace Skills
title: Psychological Safety
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Psychological Safety.

hook.text: Google's Project Aristotle found the top predictor of team success was psychological safety, not talent or resources.

buildup.text: Psychological safety means people believe they won't be punished for speaking up, asking questions, or making mistakes.

discovery.text: Leaders create safety by responding to bad news calmly, thanking the messenger, and asking 'what can we learn?'

twist.text: Safety doesn't mean no accountability. It means people can fail without fear while still being held to high standards.

climax.text: In your next meeting, ask: 'What's one thing that might go wrong that we haven't discussed?' Watch the room open up.

punchline.text: Reward the messenger. Punish the cover-up. Safety grows.

quiz.question: What did Google's Project Aristotle find as the top predictor of team success?
options: Individual talent and IQ of team members
Psychological safety — the belief that speaking up won't be punished
